name: Renbrook School Summer Adventure
description_short: A day camp at Renbrook School in West Hartford for children age 3 through Grade 9, run by teachers and educators. Summer 2027 runs June 14–July 30 in three two-week sessions, plus a one-week Pre-Season Camp.
swim_waterfront_notes: The site has a "Life at the Pool" page and lists swimming as an activity. Details such as lessons and supervision are not on this page.
